description: prioritetinių duomenų rinkinys (atitinkantis) - INSPIRE ATOM atsisiuntimo paslauga (iš anksto nustatyti duomenų rinkiniai) mažoms vandens tiekimo zonoms is a dataset listed in Geoportal of Lithuania, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by inspire-geoportal.lt. This service provides data on the Small water supply zones in Lithuania. Coverage: LT. The portal shows the English title as "INSPIRE Priority Data Set (Compliant) - INSPIRE ATOM Download Service (predefined datasets) for Small water supply zones" (machine-translated by the portal). It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geoportal-lt.
